tools.name: list_covered_countries
tools.description: The countries Pensionarch, each with its ISO code and one sourced line, and the mapped countries with the institution that pays their old age pension.

tools.name: country_pension_facts
tools.description: One country's facts, the official free routes first, then what is hard from abroad by scheme and process, what the money is worth and dated obligations. Every fact carries its source and read date. Pass question or pensionType to get one kind of pension.

tools.name: check_work_history
tools.description: For each country in a work history: whether a pension is likely to exist and why, the official free routes first, what is hard from abroad and any dated obligation that applies. Years may be exact, rough or unknown.

tools.name: resolve_employer
tools.description: Places an employer name in a country and lists the employers we hold that it may mean, each with a confidence from 0 to 1. For employers we researched it adds what the employer became and its workplace pension plan, each fact with source and read date. Legal entities only.

tools.name: authority_answer
tools.description: What a national pension institution told us in writing, as published on our answers page, with the institution, the date of the reply and the link. The question is free text, matched to the questions we hold answers to.

tools.name: deadline_check
tools.description: The date a departure deadline runs out, from our deadline register and the date the person left or died, with the official source and read date. Where the start event depends on the person's circumstances, the date is an estimate and says what to confirm. Nothing is stored.

tools.name: create_order_link
tools.description: Returns our order page with the report and countries filled in. Fees: Country $99 per country, Enhanced $199 for one country, Global $299. Payment opens only when the person chooses to pay there, so send only countries and the tier, never personal details.

tools.name: gpfr_info
tools.description: What GPFR, the Global Pension Finding Register, is, in the caller's language, with the register page, the consent text and its version and, with a country, our fund pages. Show the consent text to the person before gpfr_register. Read only.

tools.name: gpfr_register
tools.description: Registers a person in GPFR after they said yes to the consent sentence from gpfr_info, shown word for word. It sends one confirmation email and the registration stays pending until they click its link. At most 3 emails a day per address.

tools.name: gpfr_status
tools.description: The status of a GPFR registration. Without a code it emails a one-time code to the registered address, with the code it returns one status word. At most 3 emails a day per address.

tools.name: gpfr_fund_count
tools.description: For fund-side agents: how many confirmed people are registered for a pension fund, shown from 10 upwards, otherwise fewer than 10. An aggregate only.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "gpfr_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_covered_countries" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
